G27_wider_battery.verdict: external 2-bit DEGRADES ~25% vs bf16 -- NOT full-Doctor-valid, not promotable as-is. 5/6 smoke was misleading (S034 §8 vindicated). It is a specimen + a repair case, not a finished successor.

G28_prime_diagnosis.verdict: LOW-MARGIN first-token flip (0.875). The 2-bit logits are noisier at a low-confidence branch point; a minimal correction restoring the margin repairs it. Not a deep failure -> Doctor-guided minimal repair (S034 §9-10) is the right tool, not raising the whole model to q3.

implication: Phase-C path validated: 2-bit base (cheap, ~coherent) + minimal Doctor-guided correction (recover the ~25% lost capability by restoring low-margin sensitive predictions) = the matryoshka NX. Next: localize which organ's 2-bit quant costs the margin (G28 organ localization) -> minimal repair (G29).

G28_organ_localization.verdict: ATTENTION is the sensitive organ (0.56 vs 0.38). External over-compressed attention to 2-bit; our q3 keeps it at 4.25 bpw and stays 0.96-capable. Repair target = restore attention precision (629MB organ, cheap) -> recover the ~25% loss while keeping most byte savings on MLP/deltanet.
